text.aria-label: Title text 'Substation card D5 (ENC-c, direction F1)'

Subtitle text 'Provisional: fitted to past weather, forecast on ENS, screening run. Patch weights are not identified individually (neighbouring cells share an ENS box); read the ring and east-west contrast, not one cell. No physical direction is claimed from one site. Cold snap (coldest 5% of days, 7 days in this scored year): too few days to score. Weeks: GAM-K blue, ENC-c orange, observed dashed black; median and 80% band.'
text.tspan: Provisional: fitted to past weather, forecast on ENS, screening run. Patch weights are not
identified individually (neighbouring cells share an ENS box); read the ring and east-west
contrast, not one cell. No physical direction is claimed from one site. Cold snap (coldest 5%
of days, 7 days in this scored year): too few days to score. Weeks: GAM-K blue, ENC-c orange,
observed dashed black; median and 80% band.
